verdict.rationale: Next.js documents streaming UI from the server with React Suspense and the App Router, which is the mechanism behind progressive, per-boundary interactivity. It also lets you add server components that ship no client JavaScript, reducing what must hydrate. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions progressive or selective hydration, nor that pages become interactive faster. missing for 10: explicit documentation of progressive/selective hydration, control over hydration priority or order, time-to-interactive measurements or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can hydrate my server-rendered app progressively so pages become interactive faster

citations.quote: Instantly stream UI from the server, integrated with the App Router and React Suspense.
Add components without sending additional client-side JavaScript.
